test_case.test_name: Topology-bound miniHPL numerical correctness, artifacts and health qualification
test_case.purpose: Run the exact topology-sized miniHPL recipe, prove all intended GPUs participate, validate AGFHC_SUCCESS [0], miniHPL PASS and approved numerical residual with complete result.json/log artifacts, and detect any stress-window health regression.
required_package: Exact row-2062 variant plus SUT/GPU/driver/firmware topology
Approved AGFHC/miniHPL binary/version/checksum and recipe checksum
Exact N, NB, PxQ, iteration and blocking configuration with GPU participation map
Corrected status-code map plus residual/error, skipped-test and timeout acceptance
Dedicated no-load authorization, GPU/RAS/kernel/BMC/thermal/power aborts, artifact storage and recovery
test_case.test_command: STRESS-GATED; preserve logs and verify tool/recipe/topology identity, including N/NB/PxQ/iterations/blocking and intended GPU participation. Start independent health monitoring and timestamped error baseline; obtain authorization. Run exactly `agfhc -t minihpl` once, retain complete stdout/stderr/exit and the printed immutable log directory, then collect/hash result.json and all generated logs. Evaluate context-corrected AGFHC_SUCCESS [0], miniHPL PASS, executed/skipped counts, timeout status, numerical residual/rate and monitor/log deltas independently. Do not change recipe, clear logs or rerun.
test_case.expected_result: All intended GPUs execute the approved grid/problem once; output ends AGFHC_SUCCESS [0], miniHPL/result.json report PASS with zero disallowed skip/timeout and residual within the signed tolerance, artifacts are complete, and no new GPU/RAS/kernel/BMC/thermal/power fault occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires approved tool/recipe, exact participation, corrected [0] success, miniHPL PASS, accepted residual, complete artifacts and clean health. FAIL on nonzero/failure code, failed/skipped/timed-out test, residual violation, missing artifact/GPU or health error. Missing recipe/tolerance/approval is NOT READY; terminal summary alone cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Topology-sized HPL stress requires dedicated authorized SUT and no competing GPU workload.
Do not alter N/NB/PxQ/blocking/iterations during or after failure.
Monitor GPU/RAS/kernel/BMC/thermal/power and stop on numerical, device, error or limit failure.
Preserve complete artifacts/logs; no clearing, automatic rerun or parameter-reduced retry.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/Variant/hash and explicit `10]` to `[0]` defect reconciliation
Tool/recipe checksums, topology, N/NB/PxQ/iterations/blocking and participation map
Complete terminal output/exit and immutable generated log directory/result.json hashes
Status, executed/skipped/timeout, residual/rate and GPU participation analysis
Post-health/no-clear/no-rerun audit, recovery state and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On numerical/status/timeout/artifact/health failure, stop and preserve terminal, result.json, logs and monitor streams. Quiesce miniHPL and use only approved GPU/service recovery under human control; do not change recipe or rerun automatically.
